mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP above 2% annualized growth rate indicates a strong demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where GDP growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in unemployment rate below 5% signals a tight labor market, leading to increased wage pressure and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where unemployment rate is below 5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production above 1% monthly growth rate indicates a strong supply environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where industrial production growth exceeds 1%.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between federal funds rate and CPI inflation rate signals an easing monetary cycle when FEDFUNDS is below 1% and CPIAUCSL is above 2%, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between GDP and housing starts signals a strong demand environment when GDPC1 is above 2% and HOUST is above 1 million, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where GDP growth exceeds 2% and housing starts exceed 1 million.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in payroll employment below 100,000 signals a weak labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where payroll employment is below 100,000.

mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate above 2% signals a tightening monetary cycle, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days in a late-cycle expansion regime.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where federal funds rate exceeds 2% in a late-cycle expansion regime.
